service.method: SELECT MODULE FROM SIFLH WHERE #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND MODULE = ${MODULE}
UPDATE SIFLH SET LAST_EXECUTE_DATE = ${EXECUTE_DATE}, LAST_EXECUTE_TIME = ${EXECUTE_TIME} WHERE #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND MODULE = ${MODULE}
INSERT INTO SIFLD ( IF_NUMBER, MODULE, EXECUTE_DATE, EXECUTE_TIME, IF_TYPE ) VALUES ( ${IF_NUMBER}, ${MODULE}, ${EXECUTE_DATE}, ${EXECUTE_TIME}, ${IF_TYPE} )

SELECT REPLACE(DATE(LEDT),'-','') AS LAST_EXECUTE_DATE, REPLACE(DATE_FORMAT(LEDT,'%T'),':','') AS LAST_EXECUTE_TIME FROM ( SELECT CONCAT(LH.LAST_EXECUTE_DATE, CASE WHEN LH.LAST_EXECUTE_TIME = '000000' THEN '000001' ELSE LH.LAST_EXECUTE_TIME end) AS LEDT FROM SIFLH LH WHERE LH.MODULE = ${MODULE} ) LH
